name: 人脸融合边界分析
algorithm: Face Blend Boundary — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method detects face blending boundaries for deepfake detection:

1. **混合边界Localization**: The boundary where a generated/swapped face meets the original video is detected. This is typically an oval or irregular contour around the face where alpha blending, Poisson blending, or feathered compositing was applied. The boundary is localized using gradient analysis and texture transition detection.

2. **边界梯度分析**: At the blending boundary, the method measures gradient profiles perpendicular to the boundary. Natural skin-to-hair/neck transitions show anatomically motivated gradients. Artificial blending creates characteristic smooth transition zones with unnatural gradient profiles — too uniform or too symmetrical compared to natural boundaries.

3. **颜色Discontinuity检测**: Even with sophisticated blending (Poisson editing), subtle color discontinuities persist at the boundary. The method detects these by analyzing color channel differences across the boundary in multiple color spaces (RGB, Lab, YCbCr). The CIE ΔE color difference is computed across the boundary.

4. **纹理频率Mismatch**: The spatial frequency content (texture) on either side of the blending boundary is compared. Generated face texture (inside the boundary) often differs from original footage texture (outside) — different noise characteristics, sharpness, or compression artifacts. This frequency mismatch is detectable even when color blending is well-executed.

5. **时间边界稳定性**: The blending boundary position and width should remain consistent relative to the face across frames. The method tracks boundary characteristics over time — unstable or shifting boundary artifacts indicate per-frame independent face generation with inconsistent blending, yielding elevated forensic scores.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through face blend boundary analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Li, Y. et al. (2020). Face X-ray for More General Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
